text:
jay (oncall): noticing increased 503s from us-west2 GPU pool, ~30% of requests failing, autoscaler not bringing up new nodes
alex (eng-runtime): seeing queue depth spike on allocator, KV cache pressure high, can we shift non-critical traffic to eu-west?
maria (eng-sre): i'm on it — will start controlled traffic shift and update the failover routing policy. tagging cheng for infra capacity checks :wave:
cheng (infra): confirmed: two rack-level IB links flapped, NICs recovered but some GPUs in the pool stayed in unhealthy state. rolling restart queued nodes now.
jay (oncall): ok, start gradual shift. use `rdrctl route shift` with weight 20% increments every 5m. keep canary groups off the affected models.
alex (eng-runtime): running command now:
```bash
# shift 20% traffic to eu-west for model: redwood-v1
rdrctl route shift --model redwood-v1 --from us-west2 --to eu-west --percent 20
```
incident-bot: AUTO: routing-change applied by alex (eng-runtime) — id=rc-20240501-01 — details: 20% to eu-west
maria (eng-sre): metrics look better after first 20%. error-rate down from 32% to 18%. continuing to 60% over next 15m unless we see regressions.
sam (product): heads-up: embeddings batch jobs on us-west2 will be throttled; expect some latency for background jobs.
alex (eng-runtime): can we mark the us-west2 GPU pool as degraded in the console and set fallback to dedicated-noncritical? makes retries land in cheaper dedicated pool.
cheng (infra): doing that now — changed pool state to DEGRADED and updated fallback rule. also filing a hardware ticket for the affected racks.
jay (oncall): post-incident notes: this hit two things — link flaps + slow autoscaler recovery due to desync with instance metadata cache. we should update playbook to include explicit metadata cache flush step.
maria (eng-sre): agreed. patching runbook now. propose new step:
```
- After link flap recovery: run `rdrctl infra flush-metadata --pool <pool>`
- Verify allocator picks up new node states within 2m
- If not, trigger manual restart of agent on affected hosts
```
Will open PR with the text and a test checklist.
alex (eng-runtime): also add a step for pre-shift canary: run a quick perf eval against eu-west model variants to catch quantization mismatches. saved us once in previous incident.
sam (product): add a bullet to notify downstream teams for heavy batch jobs so they can delay non-critical runs; minimize surprises.
jay (oncall): action items (assign):
- maria: PR to update failover runbook + add metadata-flush step. target: today EOD.
- cheng: hardware ticket + post-repair validation log. include serials and rack IDs. target: 48h.
- alex: add automated check in routing pipeline to prevent >50% shift without perf eval. target: next sprint.
- sam: notify customers on status page about degraded region and mitigation steps (short note). target: 2h.
maria (eng-sre): created draft PR: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/412 — includes steps, sample `rdrctl` commands, and a verification checklist. request reviews from cheng + alex.
cheng (infra): i pushed hardware ticket: HT-8843 and scheduled tech to visit rack tomorrow. leaving note to run `nvidia-smi -q` post-service to confirm GPU health.
jay (oncall): final: next time let's run controlled prefix cache invalidation early in the incident timeline — adding to playbook. good job team, closing incident once postmortem doc is up. :tada:
incident-bot: INCIDENT_CLOSED: incident#2024-05-01-us-west2-gpu-degraded — duration 52m — summary: partial link failure + autoscaler metadata lag — follow-ups assigned.
